fields.statement: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg.csproj declares the same Version and the same Microsoft.Orleans package references and versions as ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql.csproj, references exactly the ArgentSea.Orleans and ArgentSea.Pg projects, packs readme.md and argentsea-logo.png at the package root, and packs common.psql and tenant.psql in the package's sql folder.
fields.scope: The ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg project file and the NuGet package it produces.
